bio_en: Misak Tanjoyan, called Chalpapakh, was a young Ottoman Armenian of about 28-29 who fought in all of Andranik's battles, always in Andranik's own ten, including the last events in Sasun. He also fought in the Caucasian clashes, always in the vanguard and never wounded, so that he came to believe that bullets could not kill him. He lived for months in besieged Tabriz, little known because of his modesty. He was killed in the fighting in the Khiavan quarter of Tabriz in March 1909.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: high. Quote #11 ('My fate is different...') is his. Birth year not stated (age 28-29 at death).
